Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

routine — what you do every day. Example: On a normal day my routine starts at seven.
morning — the time before midday. Example: In the morning I have breakfast.
evening — the time at the end of the day. Example: In the evening I watch a film.
schedule — a plan of times and activities. Example: My schedule is full.
day — twenty-four hours. Example: It is my perfect day.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• On a normal day I ...
• On my perfect day I ...
• In the morning I ...
• In the evening I ...
• It is my perfect day.
